squat.stance: Feet shoulder-width, toes turned out slightly, weight through heels and mid-foot.
squat.breathing: Breathe in before you descend, breathe out as you drive up.
squat.caution: Keep your back straight and knees tracking over your toes, never caving in.

hinge.stance: Feet hip-width, weight close over mid-foot, slight bend in the knees.
hinge.breathing: Breathe in and brace your core before lifting, exhale at the top.
hinge.caution: Hinge at the hips, not the spine. Keep a flat back and the weight close to you.

bridge.stance: Feet flat and hip-width so shins are vertical at the top.
bridge.breathing: Exhale as you drive the hips up, inhale as you lower.
bridge.caution: Squeeze your glutes at the top and don’t over-arch the lower back.

olympic.stance: Hip-width feet for the pull, then split front/back to catch the jerk.
olympic.breathing: Breathe in and hold through the pull and catch, exhale once stable.
olympic.caution: Highly technical: start with an empty bar and learn it with a coach.

lunge.stance: Step long enough that both knees bend to about 90°, torso upright, weight in the front heel.
lunge.breathing: Inhale on the way down, exhale as you push back up.
lunge.caution: Don’t let the front knee cave in; lower the back knee gently, no slamming.

push.stance: Feet planted (push-up: straight line head to heels), shoulder blades squeezed together.
push.breathing: Inhale as you lower toward the chest, exhale as you press.
push.caution: Keep elbows about 45° from the body, not flared, to protect the shoulders.

dips.stance: Grip the bars firmly, arms locked, legs together or crossed behind you.
dips.breathing: Inhale as you lower, exhale as you press back up.
dips.caution: Go down only until upper arms are parallel; shorten the range if shoulders hurt.

overhead.stance: Feet hip-width, glutes and abs braced so your torso stays rigid.
overhead.breathing: Breathe in before pressing, exhale at lockout.
overhead.caution: Don’t arch your back to help the press; start light, shoulders injure easily.

pull.stance: Stable feet (standing or seated), chest open, shoulders away from ears.
pull.breathing: Exhale as you pull in, inhale as you return.
pull.caution: Pull with your back, leading with the elbows. No swinging or momentum.

hang.stance: Grip slightly wider than shoulders, legs together or crossed to stop swinging.
hang.breathing: Exhale as you pull up, inhale as you lower slowly.
hang.caution: Lower to full extension under control. Beginners: use a band or do negatives.

arms.stance: Stand hip-width with soft knees, elbows pinned to your sides.
arms.breathing: Exhale as you curl/press, inhale as you return.
arms.caution: Keep upper arms still, don’t swing your body; pick a weight you can control.

machine.stance: Adjust the seat so your knee lines up with the machine’s pivot, back against the pad.
machine.breathing: Exhale on the effort, inhale on the return.
machine.caution: Move slowly with control; don’t let the stack slam or lock your knees.

core.stance: Feet/elbows planted, body in one straight line, hips neither high nor sagging.
core.breathing: Breathe steadily, never hold your breath; exhale at the hardest squeeze.
core.caution: Don’t yank your neck. Stop and regress if your lower back hurts.

plyo.stance: Land on the balls to mid-foot with soft knees to absorb impact.
plyo.breathing: Breathe rhythmically with the jumps, never hold your breath.
plyo.caution: Always warm up, use a non-slip floor, start with low reps and build up.

cardio.stance: Land with feet under your body, short quick steps, upright torso, relaxed shoulders.
cardio.breathing: Breathe rhythmically; if you can’t speak in sentences, slow down.
cardio.caution: Warm up for 5 minutes, wear supportive shoes and stay hydrated.

cycle.stance: Set the seat so the knee stays slightly bent at the bottom; mid-foot on the pedal.
cycle.breathing: Breathe deep and steady with your pedal or stroke rhythm.
cycle.caution: Keep your back straight, no hunching (rower: legs first, then pull with the arms).

swim.stance: Keep your body long and level; kick from the hips, not the knees.
swim.breathing: Exhale fully underwater, then turn your head to inhale rhythmically.
swim.caution: Warm up your shoulders, swim where there’s supervision, rest when tired.

yoga.stance: Spread weight evenly through both feet, rooting the whole sole into the floor.
yoga.breathing: Long breaths in and out through the nose; let the breath lead the movement.
yoga.caution: Stretch only as far as feels OK, never into pain. Blocks or straps are fine.

sport.stance: Soft knees, weight on the balls of your feet, ready to move any direction.
sport.breathing: Breathe steadily and use breaks between points to recover with deep breaths.
sport.caution: Warm up ankles and knees first and wear shoes suited to the court or field.

general.stance: Feet firmly planted about hip-width, torso upright, core braced.
general.breathing: Exhale on the effort, inhale as you release. Don’t hold your breath.
general.caution: Start with low weight or speed and stop right away if anything hurts.
